lines.text: Jacob meets the angels of God, names the place Mahanaim, and sends messengers ahead to Esau in Edom.
Jacob tells his messengers to say he has been staying with Laban and now has oxen, donkeys, and flocks.
The messengers report that Esau is coming with six hundred men, so Jacob divides his people into two camps.
Jacob prays for deliverance from Esau and reminds God of the promise of offspring like the sand of the sea.
Jacob entrusts the herds to his sons and tells them to keep some distance between the herds.
